text:
maria: Heads up — onboarding `wizard-13b` hit a weird failure in the HF->Redwood converter. Generation looks fine locally but after conversion chat templates lose the <|system|> token and replies get shifted.
hao: hmm. can you paste the converter log? did the tokenizer config.json have special_tokens or add_bos/add_eos flags?
maria: pasted excerpt below:
```
INFO: loading shards: 2/4
WARN: missing shard index entry for weights-00002.safetensors
ERROR: tokenizer special tokens mismatch: expected ['<|system|>','<|user|>'] got ['<|user|>']
Traceback (most recent call last): KeyError: 'model.layers.10.self_attn.q_proj.weight'
```
jon: missing shard index + keyerror at the same time suggests partial download of safetensors shards. did the hub retry/authorization fail mid-stream?
maria: we see 200,200,403,200 in the hf download logs around the same time. hf-sync-bot: replicated logs:
```
GET https://huggingface.co/org/wizard-13b/snapshot/abc123/weights-00002.safetensors 403
GET https://huggingface.co/org/wizard-13b/snapshot/abc123/weights-00002.safetensors 200
```
lydia: aha — if the converter streams shards and a 403 happens and then a retry provides a different revision (or a partially uploaded shard), index.json can point to keys not present in the downloaded file. Also weight key renames across revisions are common (we saw q_proj -> qkv_proj rename in an earlier revision of another model).
jaon: (typo) jon: i mean — the KeyError path shows an expected q_proj but the shard has qkv. so the converter should either pin the revision or validate all shard checksums before starting extraction.
hao: agreed. proposal:
- always pin `revision` when calling HF snapshot in converter (fallback: fail hard if not pinned)
- download all shards + index.json then verify checksums / sizes
- detect key-name families and run a small migration map (q_proj/qkv_proj, out_proj -> o_proj) with a warning
- if tokenizer special tokens mismatch, merge special_tokens_map from both config.json and tokenizer.json instead of dropping system token
maria: quick patch I tested: added preflight verify step that MD5-checks all shard files against index.json then fails early. fixed the <|system|> missing issue (it was due to tokenizer.json being overridden by a stale config.json during merge). patch diff:
```
# converter preflight
for s in index['safetensors_shards']:
    download(s['url'])
    assert md5(local) == s['md5']
# only after all verified do we extract and apply key remaps
```
jon: nice. how often do we expect HF to rename weight keys across revisions? we should surface a mapping warning to the user.
lydia: not that often but it happens when upstream refactors q/k/v into qkv for fused ops. we should at least produce a deterministic mapping file + opt-in automatic remap.
hf-sync-bot: NOTE: the model `org/wizard-13b` has 3 snapshots in last 30 days. latest snapshot changed `q_proj`->`qkv_proj` and updated tokenizer config.
maria: next steps: i'll push a unit test that simulates partial 403 mid-download and a golden index with mismatched keys. hao can you add the revision-pin + checksum preflight to the converter? jon can you draft the remap table and warning UX? lydia pls advise on tokenizer merge policy.
hao: on it, will open PR with tests.
jon: will draft remap heuristics and a `--allow-key-remap` flag.
lydia: will write the tokenizer merge spec. we should preserve any `special_tokens_map` that contains system/user definitions and merge rather than prefer one file.
maria: thanks — adding :eyes: and will follow up if anything else breaks. build-bot: conversion job 1854321000 started
build-bot: conversion job 1854321000 failed -> logs uploaded: https://internal.builds/1854321000/logs
maria: linking to the failing converter run here for traceability. that's all for now.
